- Accept the pilot with a short-term risk acceptance (60-day review) so we can start P0 integration earlier.
- Narrow the SOW to a single app for an initial pilot to reduce exposure and speed approval.
- If you want, we can host a 20–30 minute legal-only walkthrough for Sara to go through each redline.
